heading: l2: disk full
body:
Open Settings → System → Storage. Check which drive is full. Click "Temporary files" → tick Recycle Bin, Temporary files, Delivery Optimization Files → Remove.

Asked by: l2 | Topic: disk full | If this does not resolve in two attempts, that is an L2 escalation — call (647) 581-3182.
